name: modern-drivers-app
description: Modern Drivers — Android driver tracking app for Modern Dairy, Pune (Capacitor)

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

_comment_native_project: The android/ project is GENERATED at build time with `npx cap add android`, not committed. The Modern Drivers app has no hand-written native code, so a committed native tree would only be 200+ files of generated Gradle config to keep in sync with the Capacitor version. The workflow .github/workflows/build-drivers-apk.yml generates it, patches the manifest for the background-location permissions the plugin needs, and builds the APK. Run `npm run add:android` locally to get the same tree.
_comment_permissions: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION are added by scripts/patch-drivers-manifest.js after `cap add android`. Google Play requires a written justification for background location — see docs/modern-drivers/PLAY_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.md before submitting.
